# MapEditToolbar

Pointr Cloud's map edit toolbar (CLOUD-UI-005): one part for its seven geometry toolbars, a card on the map of tools, actions and dividers, with one tool chosen at a time. A Dashboard module: it ships from `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`, with `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard.css` loaded after the package's `style.css`, and only on the web.

- **Import:** `import { MapEditToolbar } from "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard";`
- **Stylesheet:** `import "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard.css";`, after the package's `style.css`: a Dashboard module's rules are in this sheet alone.
- **Group:** Dashboard
- **Platforms:** React; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/dashboard-mapedittoolbar--docs>

## Example

From its `Create` story.

```tsx
import {
  Circle,
  Code02,
  FlipBackward,
  FlipForward,
  MarkerPin01,
  Pentagon,
  XSquare,
} from "@kozmos-ds/icons";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";
import {
  MapEditToolbar,
  type MapEditToolbarItem,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard";

const CREATE_ITEMS: MapEditToolbarItem[] = [
  { type: "tool", id: "polygon", label: "Polygon", icon: Pentagon },
  { type: "tool", id: "point", label: "Point", icon: MarkerPin01 },
  { type: "tool", id: "circle", label: "Circle", icon: Circle },
  { type: "divider" },
  { type: "tool", id: "json", label: "JSON", icon: Code02 },
  { type: "divider" },
  {
    type: "action",
    id: "undo",
    label: "Undo",
    icon: FlipBackward,
    disabled: true,
  },
  {
    type: "action",
    id: "redo",
    label: "Redo",
    icon: FlipForward,
    disabled: true,
  },
  { type: "action", id: "clear", label: "Clear", icon: XSquare },
];

export function MapEditToolbarExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <MapEditToolbar label="Geometry tools" items={CREATE_ITEMS} />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## MapEditToolbar

Pointr Cloud's map edit toolbar (CLOUD-UI-005): the one part behind its
seven geometry toolbars. A card on the map (radius 16, padding 6 and 8,
60 tall) of 56 × 48 items, each a 24 icon over an 11/14 label: tools,
ToggleButtons with one at most pressed (decision 151), actions, and
dividers. The product decides which items each mode shows.

It is one tab stop (role="toolbar"): the arrow keys move between its
items in the writing direction, and Home and End go to the first and the
last. On a map too narrow for it, the items that do not fit go, from the
end, into a More menu, never off-screen.

A Dashboard module (decision 183): import it from
`@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`, with `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard.css` after
the package's style.css.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `MapEditToolbarProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "defaultValue" | "onChange" | "children">`.

- `label`: `string`, **required**.

  The toolbar's accessible name ("Geometry tools").

- `items`: `MapEditToolbarItem[]`, **required**.

  The items, in reading order: tools, actions and dividers. The product
  decides which show in each mode; the toolbar draws them.

- `value`: `string | null`, optional.

  The chosen tool's id, or null for none. Controlled.

- `defaultValue`: `string | null`, optional, default `null`.

  The tool chosen at first, uncontrolled.

- `onValueChange`: `(value: string | null) => void`, optional.

  A tool was pressed: its id, or null when the chosen tool was pressed
  again and let go. A controlled toolbar that must always have a tool
  keeps its value.

- `onAction`: `(id: string) => void`, optional.

  An action was pressed: its id.

- `field`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  Drawn in the card before the items, outside their arrow-key order: the
  GeoJSON field of Cloud's JSON mode. Give it a label of its own.

- `moreLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"More"`.

  The overflow menu's button's label.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### MapEditToolbarItem

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
type MapEditToolbarItem =
  | MapEditToolbarTool
  | MapEditToolbarAction
  | MapEditToolbarDivider;
```

### MapEditToolbarTool

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
/**
 * A tool: a mode the map is in while it is chosen (Polygon, Adjust, Split).
 * One tool at most is chosen at a time; it is a ToggleButton, pressed.
 */
interface MapEditToolbarTool extends MapEditToolbarControl {
  type: "tool";
}
```

### MapEditToolbarAction

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
/** An action: done once when pressed (Undo, Clear, Straighten). */
interface MapEditToolbarAction extends MapEditToolbarControl {
  type: "action";
}
```

### MapEditToolbarDivider

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
/** A line between two groups of items. */
interface MapEditToolbarDivider {
  type: "divider";
}
```

### MapEditToolbarControl

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
/** What a tool or an action shows and says. */
interface MapEditToolbarControl {
  /** The product's id for it: what `value`, `onValueChange` and `onAction` carry. */
  id: string;
  /** The words under the icon, and its accessible name. */
  label: string;
  /** A named export of `@kozmos-ds/icons` (decision 121), drawn at 24. */
  icon: KozmosIconComponent;
  /**
   * Unavailable now. As every Kozmos button, a disabled item is skipped by
   * the keyboard and the pointer, and drawn at half strength.
   */
  disabled?: boolean;
  /**
   * More than the label says, shown on hover and keyboard focus ("Double
   * click to finish drawing"). Leave it unset where it would repeat the
   * label: the label is always drawn. A disabled item shows none.
   */
  tooltip?: string;
}
```

### KozmosIconComponent

From `@kozmos-ds/icons`.

```ts
/**
 * An icon is an outline owned by this package or a taxonomy symbol, and both
 * are drawn from the Pointr Icon Library's own artwork. Until 2026-09-23 this
 * union had a third arm, `LucideIcon`, and 43 of the 64 names resolved to it:
 * the same concept in a different hand from the one Figma shows. Every one had
 * an exact Pointr equivalent by name, so nothing here maps onto a near-miss
 * any more. Both take the same props, so a consumer cannot tell them apart.
 */
type KozmosIconComponent =
  | ReturnType<typeof createPointrIcon>
  | ReturnType<typeof createTaxonomyIcon>;
```
